noFileOnCloud: No file found on Google Drive
errorObjectNotFaustCompatible: Content is not compatible with Faust
errorGettingAudioInput: Could not enable microphone or audio input
midiUnavailable: MIDI is not available in this browser: the MIDI to CV module needs Web MIDI (Chrome, Edge, Firefox)
midiRefused: The access to the MIDI devices was refused: the MIDI to CV module will not play
librarySearchHint: The search looks for every word in the names of the modules, their Faust functions, their families and their descriptions, ignoring case and accents. ↑ ↓ choose a module, Enter adds it, Escape clears the search.
microphoneIdle: Microphone: off. Click, or draw a cable from it, to turn it on (the browser asks for the permission)
errorInputAPINotAvailable: The microphone or audio input cannot be used in your browser
errorAccSliderNotFound: Could not find slider, modifications on the slider will not be exported in the final version of the application
errorAccelerometerNotFound: Could not find accelerometer, modifications on the slider will not be exported in the final version of the application
errorNoWebAudioAPI: It appears that your browser does not support the Web Audio API. Try with a more recent version of the browser
errorFactory: The provided Faust code is not correct:
errorJsonCorrupted: This file is corrupt and cannot be loaded
errorCreateDSP: Cannot create the DSP file, the Faust code contains errors
errorCreateModuleRecall: An error occured while creating the module, the save file is probably corrupt
errorConnectionRecall: An error occured while connecting modules, the save file is probably corrupt
connectionsRemovedByArity: Module {name} now has {inputs} input(s) and {outputs} output(s): {count} connection(s) to ports that no longer exist were removed
modulationFailed: The modulation could not be created: {reason}
modulationsRemoved: Modulations removed, their widgets no longer exist in the new code: {widgets}
modulationPortHint: drag vertically to set the depth (Shift: fine), double click to set it back to its default (± 0.5, + and ~ 1)
volumeHint: drag vertically to set the volume of the scene (Shift: fine), horizontally to move the module; double click to mute or unmute
errorLocalStorage: Your browser does not support local storage
errorConnectionCloud: Unable to connect to Google Drive
rulesSceneName: Only alphabet letters and numbers are accepted. Spaces, apostrophes and accents are automatically replaced. The name cannot start with a number. It must be between 1 and 50 characters.
confirmSuppr: Do you really want to delete this Patch?
confirmReplace: The name you are using already exists, if you continue the existing file will be replaced. You can rename the scene in the Export tab. Replace?
confirmEmptyScene: Do you really want to empty the scene?
buttonChangeSceneName: Change the name of the application
modulesNotExported: Modules not connected to the output, not exported: {names}
successRenameScene: The name has been changed successfully
noDeviceMotion: It appears that your browser does not support the Device Motion API, you will therefore be unable to access the accelerometers of your device.
editInFaustcode: Edit the code in faustcode: every successful compilation (Cmd/Ctrl-S) updates the module
faustcodePopupBlocked: The browser blocked the faustcode window: allow pop-ups for this site
faustcodeNoAnswer: faustcode does not answer ({url}): this version may not know the link with faustmodular
faustcodeUpdateFailed: {name}: the code received from faustcode was not applied ({error})
confirmReplaceScene: The current scene has been modified since it was last saved. Replace it anyway?
documentOpenFileHint: A patch (.json, .jfaust) opens as a new document; a Faust file (.dsp) becomes a module of the scene.
documentModified: Modified since last saved (Cmd/Ctrl-S to save)
confirmEmptyTrash: Delete the documents of the trash for good?
documentStorageLocal: This browser has no private file system (OPFS): documents are kept in the local storage, limited to a few MB.
documentStorageMemory: No storage available: documents will be lost when the tab is closed. Export them.
moduleDuplicate: Duplicate this module, or the selected modules (Ctrl/Cmd-D; with Shift, without the cables coming from other modules)
moduleUpdate: Update: use the latest version of this module (Ctrl/Cmd-Z to go back)
userModulesDescription: Your modules: those whose code you changed in faustcode. Double click or drag: adds the latest version; ✎ renames; ✕ puts in the trash (Documents menu).
userModulesEmpty: Drop a .dsp file on the stage, or edit a module in faustcode: it will appear here.
confirmUserModuleDelete: Move the module “%s” to the trash? The documents using it do not change.
faustcodeLibfaustMismatch: faustcode uses libfaust {faustcode} and faustmodular libfaust {faustmodular}: their Faust libraries differ, a module may not behave the same in both.
transport: Transport of the timeline shared with the Faust applications of the browser (faust-sync)
transportPlay: Play (all the Faust applications of the browser)
transportStop: Stop (all the Faust applications of the browser)
transportClocks: Clocks: {peers} other application(s), offset frozen with {frozen}; corrections of the position: {count}
